lead.description: the factor that makes a nonnegative function integrate or sum to one

self_checks.title: Two successes
self_checks.prompt: The kernel on the unit interval is theta squared. What is its integral, and what normalizing constant turns it into a density?
self_checks.answer: The integral is 1/3 and the normalizing constant is 3.

self_checks.title: One success in two trials
self_checks.prompt: The kernel on the unit interval is theta times (1 minus theta). What is its integral, and what normalizing constant turns it into a density?
self_checks.answer: The integral is 1/6 and the normalizing constant is 6.

overview_sentence: A [normalizing constant](articles/normalizing-constant.qmd) is the factor that makes a nonnegative function integrate or sum to one.
